name: What is the remodeling process from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What is the remodeling process from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The remodeling process typically begins with initial consultation and design, where your vision and project goals are discussed. Next comes detailed planning, including architectural drawings, material selections, and permit acquisition. Once permits are secured, demolition begins, followed by structural work, framing, and utility rough-ins (plumbing, electrical, HVAC). Finish work includes insulation, drywall, flooring, cabinetry, painting, and fixture installation. The project concludes with final inspections and a walkthrough to ensure satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The remodeling process involves consultation, design, planning, permitting, demolition, structural work, utility rough-ins, finish work, and final inspections.
